mapper.select: SELECT i.indicator_code AS "indicatorCode", i.title AS "title", i.category AS "category", i.unit AS "unit", m.period_value AS "periodValue", m.numerical_value AS "numericalValue", m.data_source_type AS "dataSourceType", m.status AS "status" FROM esg_indicators i LEFT JOIN esg_metric_data m ON i.id = m.indicator_id AND m.company_id = #{companyId} AND m.reporting_year = #{year} AND m.period_type = 'MONTHLY' WHERE i.is_active = true ORDER BY i.indicator_code ASC, m.period_value ASC
